headline: U. Y. Fincorp submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Routine paperwork filed by U. Y. Fincorp
summary: U. Y. Fincorp Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. These filings are standard regulatory compliance following shareholder meetings. For an Indian retail investor, this is routine corporate governance data with no immediate financial impact on stock valuation.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for retail investors
